::: {#perfil}

PhD candidate in Applied Mathematics and Data Science at FGV EMAp, holding an MSc and 
a BSc in Economics from FGV EPGE. He works as a senior data scientist at MT2 Data.

## Education

- PhD student in Applied Mathematics and Data Science, FGV EMAp.
- MSc in Applied Mathematics and Data Science, FGV EMAp.
- MSc in Economics, FGV EPGE.
- BSc in Economics, FGV EPGE.

## Interests

Crop yield prediction and productivity estimation, satellite image time series, and self-supervised learning.
